verdict.rationale: Elastic documents serverless autoscaling that adjusts to workload spikes without manual intervention (elastic-docs-33, elastic-docs-26) and claims cost efficiency vs competitors (elastic-docs-15), suggesting smooth cost scaling. However, multiple independent community reports concretely contradict predictable costs — a team abandoned an Elastic deployment after being told licensing fees would 'eat up significant portions of the project's profits' (elastic-comm-4), and others describe the SaaS pricing as expensive vs alternatives and prone to 'nickle and diming' (elastic-comm-10, elastic-comm-12, elastic-comm-5). missing for 10: transparent usage-based pricing calculator/docs, first-party evidence rebutting the licensing-cost complaints, and confirmation that serverless billing avoids step-function cost jumps at scale.
